title: Hearty Silky Korean Beef Bibimbap
description: A rich and savory Korean dish featuring slow-cooked beef, kombu, and a variety of vegetables, served over a bed of rice.
instructions: In a large pot, combine the beef short ribs, kombu, soy sauce, Gochujang, brown sugar, garlic, and 2 cups of water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Strain the cooking liquid and discard the kombu.
Add the sesame oil to the cooking liquid and stir to combine.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of the sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Add the zucchini and shiitake mushrooms to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender and lightly browned.
To assemble the bibimbap, place a scoop of cooked white rice in the bottom of a bowl.
Add a few pieces of the slow-cooked beef on top of the rice.
Arrange the zucchini and shiitake mushrooms on top of the beef.
Drizzle the sesame oil cooking liquid over the top of the dish.
